title: Protein purification and crystallization of HLA-A∗02:01 in complex with SARS-CoV-2 peptides
protocol: Chemically transform competent BL21 (DE3) E. coli cells with the pET-30a (+) vector encoding HLA-A∗02:01 heavy chain or β2-microglobulin.
Thaw competent cells on ice.
Add 0.5–1 μL (<100 ng) of plasmid to the competent cells.
Incubate cells-DNA mixture on ice for 20 min.
Heat shock competent cells at 42°C in a water bath (or heat block) for 45 s.
Add 1 mL of sterile LB broth to the tube.
Incubate at 37°C in a shaker incubator at 180 rpm for 1 h.
Plate 50 and 100 μL of cells onto LB/agar plates with 34 μg/mL Kanamycin.
Incubate the plates in a stationary incubator for 14–17 hours at 37°C.
Inoculate two liquid starter cultures of 150 mL LB broth each, containing 34 μg/mL Kanamycin, using a single colony from each LB agar plate.
Incubate the starter cultures for 14–17 hours in a shaker incubator at 37°C and 180 rpm.
Inoculate 6× 800 mL of LB broth containing 34 μg/mL Kanamycin with 8 mL of starter culture (100-fold dilution).
Grow the cultures at 37°C until the OD 600 nm reaches 0.6, approximately 3 hours.
Add 800 μL of 0.5 M IPTG to each 800 mL culture to induce protein expression and incubate for 4 hours.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellets in MilliQ H2O (20 mL in total for the entire 6× 800 mL culture).
Store resuspended cell pellets in −80°C (long-term storage) or −20°C (short-term storage) freezer.
Thaw bacterial pellet in a 37°C water bath.
Use Enzymatic Lysis Buffer on a rotating wheel for 20 minutes at approximately 25°C for enzymatic cell lysis and DNA degradation.
Centrifuge the sample at 15,000 g at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 150 mL of Wash Buffer 1.
Add 1 mM DTT (150 μL of 1 M stock) to the resuspended pellet.
Add 0.2 mM PMSF (150 μL of 200 mM stock) to the resuspended pellet.
Homogenize and centrifuge at 10,000 g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Repeat washing steps until the pellet is clean of dark debris (minimum of 4 washes).
Discard supernatant and resuspend the clean pellet in 150 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Add 1 mM DTT (150 μL of 1 M stock) to the resuspended pellet.
Add 0.2 mM PMSF (150 μL of 200 mM stock) to the resuspended pellet.
Homogenize and centrifuge at 10,000 g at 4°C for 10 minutes.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 5 mL Guanidine·HCl Buffer for each liter of culture.
Incubate on a rotating wheel for 14–17 hours at 4°C.
Centrifuge at 30,000 g at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Harvest the supernatant.
Use SDS-PAGE for quantification.
Load wells with 2 μL of BSA as a standard.
Load wells with 4 μL of BSA as a standard.
Load wells with 8 μL of BSA as a standard.
Load diluted sample (1:10) in reduced loading dye and 8 M Urea.
Load diluted sample (1:5) in reduced loading dye and 8 M Urea.
Load undiluted sample if it appears yellow and clear.
Estimate the concentration by comparing band size and thickness to BSA control.
Aliquot human β2-microglobulin at 10 mg per aliquot.
Aliquot HLA-A*02:01 heavy chain at 30 mg per aliquot.
Store aliquots in -80°C.
Proceed to refolding steps or store inclusion bodies long term at -80°C.
Add 30 mg of HLA-A*02:01 heavy chain to 0.5 L of refolding buffer.
Add 10 mg of β2-microglobulin to the refolding buffer containing HLA-A*02:01.
Dissolve 5 mg of SARS-CoV-2 peptide in 0.4 ml DMSO and add to the refolding buffer.
Stir the mixture at approximately 25°C for 3 hours.
Place the refolding buffer into dialysis membranes (10 kDa cut-off) with 10 L of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 for 12 hours, repeating three times at 4°C.
Continue dialysis for a minimum of 36 hours to improve yield of refolded protein.
Perform ion exchange chromatography using DEAE-C for purification of the HLA-A*02:01-SARS-CoV-2 N222-230 LLLDRLNQL complex.
Prepare DEAE-C resin as described in the protocol.
Wash and equilibrate the DEAE-C resin.
Filter dialyzed protein sample using a 0.22 μm syringe filter.
Load filtered protein sample onto the column at 4°C.
Elute bound proteins with 5 CV of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl.
Visualize protein purity on SDS-PAGE.
Wash DEAE resin with 1 M NaCl followed by 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Store DEAE resin in 20% EtOH at 4°C for reuse.
Concentrate eluted protein using a centrifugal concentrator with a 10 kDa cut-off.
Perform buffer exchange over 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 four times.
Filter concentrated and exchanged protein sample with a 0.22 μm filter before loading onto the HTQ column.
Load filtered protein sample onto the HTQ column using a 5 mL loop on FPLC machine.
Wash the HTQ column with five CV of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 M NaCl.
Equilibrate the column with five column volumes of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Start fractionation before protein injection.
Ensure deep well or tubes are in the correct position for collection.
Collect 1 mL fractions during the run.
Inject protein sample and run at a flow rate of 1 mL/min.
Set a gradient from 0 to 20% of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 1 M NaCl over 20 min after two loop volumes (10 mL).
Run SDS-PAGE gel of the fractions of interest.
Pool the fractions needed based on purification profile and gel analysis.
Concentrate the protein sample using a 10 kDa cut-off concentrator.
Measure the concentration of protein using a UV spectrophotometer at 280 nm absorbance.
Concentrate the protein sample to the desired concentration for crystallization.
Store the concentrated protein sample at 4°C short term or −20°C long term.
Evaluate the purity of the protein sample prior to crystallization using SDS-PAGE.
Set up sitting drop 48-well plates according to Hampton Research commercial screening kits.
Prepare approximately 50 μl of pHLA-A∗02:01 peptide complex at a concentration of approximately 5 mg/ml in buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl).
Pipette 100 μl of crystallization solution into the deep well.
Pipette 1 μl of crystallization solution from each deep well onto the well.
Pipette 1 μl of protein sample onto the well containing crystallization solution.
Seal the plate with Crystal Clear plate Sealing Tape.
Store the plate at 20°C.
Set up sitting drop 48-well plates using the condition that produced crystals.
Pipette 1 μL of crystallization solution from each deep well onto the well.
Pipette 1 μL of protein into the well containing crystallization solution.
Add 0.2 μL of additive included in the Additive Screen HT to the drop, such as 1 mM CaCl2.
Add crystal micro seeds finely crushed into each drop if initial crystals have been obtained.
Seal the plate with Crystal Clear plate Sealing Tape and store at 20°C.
Wait until crystals appear.
